source_instruction: i need an easy to carry tripod made of carbon fiber for my camera.
query:
I swear my neighbor’s tabby cat has decided my back porch is its personal vacation rental this week. It showed up Monday afternoon all fluffy and damp from a random summer drizzle, curled up on the old wicker chair I keep out there, and now it shows up like clockwork every single day right around 2pm. I left a little bowl of water out for it the first day, and now it gives me the most judgmental stare if I don’t also have a tiny handful of tuna treats waiting when it saunters over. It even brought me a half-dead dandelion yesterday like it was paying rent, which was equal parts gross and so charming I almost let it come inside before I remembered my roommate is deathly allergic to cats.
Hey, I’m browsing the tripods & monopods section right now looking for a new one for my weekend hikes, and I need one made of fiberglass composite first off. I’m trying to keep things light on my budget for this purchase, so I don’t want to go over that unstated threshold I have in mind for what I’m comfortable shelling out. I also definitely need one that works for when I’m moving around a lot between shooting spots without hassle. Can you show me options that fit what I’m looking for?
